bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
query="SELECT p.revision FROM link_button_posts p JOIN public_post_drafts d ON d.owner_user_id=p.owner_user_id WHERE d.module='link' AND d.data->>'text'='個別編集済みの安全テスト' AND p.share_code=d.data->>'shareCode';"
v="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$query")" || exit 61
case "$v" in 1)exit 80;; 2)exit 81;; 3|4|5)exit 82;; *)exit 83;; esac
